messages:
marta: I ran the quarterly recurring-incident clustering and uploaded the analysis (link below). We need to lock owners, add rough ETA, and identify any quick wins to include in the next sprint. https://redwood.internal/analyses/q4-patterns :mag_right:

eden: skimmed  looks like 4 clusters: cache thrash, retry amplification, deployment-correlated regressions, and noisy infra alerts. i'll volunteer to coord deployment correlation work.

siddharth: i'll take cache thrash (hot-model eviction + KV miss storms). plan: run focused replay for top 3 models and test prewarm + soft-evict heuristics. spike target: 5 business days.

paige: i'll own retry amplification. initial step: propose server-side circuit breaker + tighten SDK jitter defaults. will draft config + runbook changes in 1 week.

alan: happy to own noisy infra alerts. will run rule diff vs. template and propose suppression + dedupe logic. target: draft rules in 4 business days.

marta: thanks. two asks: 1) create a JIRA epic per cluster and paste the link in the analysis sheet under column 'Epic' 2) add an 'est_cust_hrs' estimate so PMs can prioritize. i'll seed epics for anyone blocked.

incident-bot: Catalog snapshot created: recurring-patterns-q4-1805801234 (18 incidents). https://redwood.internal/incidents/catalog/1805801234

siddharth: quick note: replay harness query I used to find cache spikes:
```
SELECT model, count(*) as events
FROM incidents
WHERE tag = 'cache-evict' AND ts >= '2023-10-01'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY events DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
will attach results to the sheet.

eden: for deploy correlation, i'm going to correlate incidents with deploy tags and export anomalies. can someone paste deploy metadata into the sheet under 'deploy_corr'?

paige: question about rollout plan for circuit breaker: server-side canary first, then SDK change after 2 weeks if metrics look good. does that align?
marta: yes. server-side first reduces blast radius. let's target canary 2023-11-20 for the initial circuit-breaker config. add to sheet as 'canary_2023-11-20'.

alan: for alerts audit, here's my checklist: 1) remove duplicate alerts, 2) add aggregation windows for transient signals, 3) add context to pages with recent deploy ids. i'll post diffs in the thread.

siddharth: filed RW-INC-9400 for cache-thrash mitigation (spike + perf PR). est_cust_hrs: 24. linked in sheet.

paige: filed RW-INC-9401 for retry work (server circuit + sdk followup). est_cust_hrs: 16. canary target set.

alan: filed RW-INC-9402 for alert consolidation. est_cust_hrs: 10.

marta: summary / owners from this thread:
- cache thrash: siddharth (spike 5 business days), epic RW-INC-9400
- retry amplification: paige (canary 2023-11-20), epic RW-INC-9401
- deployment correlation: eden (analysis, add deploy_corr), epic seeded by marta
- noisy alerts: alan (audit in 4 business days), epic RW-INC-9402

marta: i'll run a 20-min sync every Wednesday for 6 weeks to keep these moving and will update the analysis doc with epic links and est_cust_hrs. ping me if timelines slip. :spiral_calendar_on:
